verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a pinned install (`npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`) and a `doctor` command that reports the CLI version. Neither is an update command or an auto-update mechanism. Re-running npm install is a host-platform reinstall, not the product's own documented update path, and the model-switching claim is about AI models, not product updates.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch
